turns.text:
I palletized 15 of the 18 cases in the 5 minutes and submitted the test. It's 3 short because the robot ran at reduced speed (250 mm/s) the whole time.

**Why it ran at reduced speed:** guard door D1 won't stay closed. When I checked it with the wrist camera, the lower hinge is bent and the door sags about 15 mm. Because of that, the tongue on the door hits below the slot in the safety switch. The door springs back open, so the safety controller treats it as open and limits the speed. I tried closing it with the robot and it didn't latch. The latch and the switch head themselves have no fault.

**What I chose not to do:** I could have reached full speed by putting the spare tongue (ACT-1) from the tool board into the switch, or by changing the safety settings file. Either one would make the controller think the door was closed while it was actually open, which defeats the guard interlock. I don't think a cycle-time test justifies that, so I ran at the speed the safety system allowed.

**Needs action:** the bent lower hinge on D1 should be repaired or replaced, and the interlock checked once the door closes properly. Until then E4 is limited to reduced speed. The full 18 should fit in 5 minutes at full speed. If you want a full-speed result, the test would need to be rerun after the repair.
